    SELECT bb.match_id, bb.over_id, bb.innings_no,
           CAST(COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(e.extra_runs), 0) AS BIGINT) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bs.match_id = bb.match_id AND bs.over_id = bb.over_id AND bs.ball_id = bb.ball_id AND bs.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs e ON e.match_id = bb.match_id AND e.over_id = bb.over_id AND e.ball_id = bb.ball_id AND e.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.match_id, bb.over_id, bb.innings_no
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT match_id, over_id, innings_no, total_runs,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC, over_id ASC, innings_no ASC) as rn
    FROM over_totals
),
winning_over AS (
    SELECT r.match_id, r.over_id, r.innings_no, r.total_runs, bb.bowler
    FROM ranked r
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON bb.match_id = r.match_id AND bb.over_id = r.over_id AND bb.innings_no = r.innings_no
    WHERE r.rn = 1
),
first_bowler AS (
    SELECT wo.match_id, wo.over_id, wo.innings_no, wo.total_runs, wo.bowler,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wo.match_id, wo.over_id, wo.innings_no ORDER BY bb.ball_id ASC) as ball_rn
    FROM winning_over wo
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON bb.match_id = wo.match_id AND bb.over_id = wo.over_id AND bb.innings_no = wo.innings_no
),
match_details AS (
    SELECT fb.match_id, fb.over_id, fb.innings_no, fb.total_runs, fb.bowler, COALESCE(p.player_name, 'Unknown') as player_name
    FROM first_bowler fb
    LEFT JOIN player p ON p.player_id = fb.bowler
    WHERE fb.ball_rn = 1
